description: Return the real attributes (fields, relations, components) of a content-type or component UID. Use this instead of guessing field names. Pass `uids` to fetch several at once.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

uids.description: Several UIDs to fetch in one call.

name: get_schema
title: Get a content-type / component schema
